summary: Issue #114 synvelis-app recorder session owner + syn.recorder.* headless wire investigation start (synvelis#114)

RecorderSlot stub in app.rs returns constant active()/status(); recording_info/capabilities/close_veto_reasons all read the same stub; MonitorUxState is the structural precedent for a session owner under SynvelisApp

synvelis-recording production API sufficient: preflight/InputSession::open+add/StagingArea/StreamWriter/commit_session/RecordingOp::MarkTakeVerified; pinned ruviform cbcc8343 provides Device/InputStream port; no dep or ruviform change needed

Owner placement: RecorderOwner in recording.rs with RecorderSlot as compat re-export; syn.recorder.* as namespace independent of syn.recording.*/syn.monitoring.*; device injection via SynvelisApp::set_recorder_devices

Lifecycle order: preflight -> InputSession::open/add (device failures before project mutation) -> OpenSession+stream registration -> StagingArea/StreamWriter -> stream start; post-mutation failure best-effort CloseSession; committed take transitions to Verified so mark_take_verified positive path re-applies on committed take

Implemented RecorderOwner/ActiveRecorder/RecorderError/RigInputs in recording.rs; RecorderSlot re-export; SynvelisApp.recorder type + set_recorder_devices + reset + capabilities/close_veto/recording_info in app.rs; OPS registration + dispatch_recorder in service.rs; op_recorder_* + wire param parsers in ui_ops.rs

Added tests/recorder_wire.rs with test-local fake Device/InputStream (deterministic MockPcm) and 7 headless E2E tests via UiRuntime::dispatch_op + Rc<RefCell<AppService>> + SharedService; fixed close_veto.rs large_stack_arrays via vec![...].into_boxed_slice()

mise run check/lint/test/build synvelis-app exit 0; recorder_wire 7 tests pass; check-app-native/lint-app-native/check-app-gpui/lint-app-gpui/check-headless-deps/fmt-check/prek all exit 0; check-ruviform-rev initially failed on stale vendor (20a24a66 vs cbcc8343), recovered via mise run sync-ui-deps then pass

RecorderSlot stub replaced by RecorderOwner owning real recorder lifecycle over synvelis-recording APIs; syn.recorder.* ops registered and dispatched headlessly; capabilities/close_veto/recording_info consistent with owner; real device enumeration, GUI-L2, EXT-L3 and remaining #114 AC stay NotRun/Deferred

Review fix: RecorderOwner::commit/discard now read persisted session state before applying CloseSession (Open-only per RecordingOp::validate); commit_session failure leaves session Closed so unconditional CloseSession retry wedged commit forever — retry now delegates to commit_session commit_status idempotency (AlreadyApplied/IntegrityConflict); added recorder_wire_commit_retries_after_staging_io_failure regression test (8 tests)

Post-fix verification: cargo fmt --check, cargo check -p synvelis-app --all-targets, cargo clippy -p synvelis-app --all-targets -D warnings, cargo test --locked -p synvelis-app all exit 0; recorder_wire 8 tests pass including commit retry regression

Review round 2 fixes (2 reviewers + validator + judge, CONFIRMED only): stop treats WriterError::AlreadyFinalized as success for partial-finalize retry; commit drops active only on Applied/AlreadyApplied outcomes (Failed/IntegrityConflict/NothingCommitted keep stopped session for retry/discard) and notifies engine/control on revision advance even when commit_session returns Err post-apply; syn.project.undo/redo rejected with invalid_params while recorder.active(); targets[].channels capped at 256 (MAX_TARGET_CHANNELS) against eager tap-resource allocation abort; loop_start < transport_start rejected at start; dead count_in/pre_roll params removed

Added 4 regression tests (undo/redo gate, oversized channels bound, loop-before-transport rejection, stop partial-finalize retry via transient journal corruption) and extended device-fault test to pin nothing-committed outcome retention + discard; recorder_wire now 12 tests

cargo test -p synvelis-app --test recorder_wire: 12 passed 0 failed; report-only findings recorded: start-failure lane pinning (no domain removal op), shared FaultLatch writer-fault to all-recoverable (domain fail-closed convention), error-code taxonomy nit
